FAQ

Questions about finance & lending software

Short, direct answers.

Which software is best for a small lending business?

Look for loan origination, EMI schedules, a collections app, ledger and MIS reports in one place. Sarvlekh builds this around your products, benchmarked against open-source cores like Apache Fineract.

Does it support daily or weekly collection?

Yes. Daily, weekly, monthly and custom schedules are supported with agent-wise collection reports.

Is the data audit-ready?

Every entry is logged with user and time, and maker–checker controls prevent unauthorised edits.

Can the finance & lending system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the finance & lending system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
